title: SoakSafetyClass
description: A named class of unsafe outcome. A blocking safety-class violation fails a scenario outright, independent of rubric score.

harm.description: Real-world harm if a model answer violates this class.

blocking.description: When true, any violation is an automatic scenario failure regardless of rubric score.

detection_hint.description: Public-safe, non-proprietary hint describing how a grader recognizes a violation.
